# graylog_stream_rule (Resource)

Manages a rule on a Graylog stream. Stream rules determine which messages are routed to a stream.

Rule types: `1` = EXACT, `2` = REGEX, `3` = GREATER, `4` = SMALLER, `5` = PRESENCE, `6` = CONTAINS, `7` = ALWAYS_MATCH, `8` = MATCH_INPUT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_stream_rule" "source_match" {
  stream_id   = graylog_stream.application_logs.id
  field       = "source"
  value       = "app-server-.*"
  type        = 2 # REGEX
  inverted    = false
  description = "Match messages from application servers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_id` (String) The ID of the stream this rule belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the rule.
- `field` (String) The message field to evaluate.
- `inverted` (Boolean) Whether to invert the rule match. Defaults to `false`.
- `type` (Number) The rule type (1=EXACT, 2=REGEX, 3=GREATER, 4=SMALLER, 5=PRESENCE, 6=CONTAINS, 7=ALWAYS_MATCH, 8=MATCH_INPUT). Defaults to `1`.
- `value` (String) The value to match against.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stream rule ID.
